events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five locations: 873 Broadway; 266 W 23rd St; 369 Madison Ave; 275 W 4th St; 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis where eight chefs serve complimentary chef-made lunches.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last, plus bodega-style scratch-off tickets with chances to win additional CookUnity meals and restaurant experiences.
events.caveats: NYC for FREE, Cititour, Time Out and same-day New York Post coverage agree on Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM and five Manhattan locations. Meals are while supplies last and lines are expected. No RSVP requirement is published. No CookUnity-owned event page was located in this pass, so the listing does not claim an official first-party event URL.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in at any of the five participating bodegas. Arrive early because complimentary meals are explicitly while supplies last.

occurrences.details: Walk-in at five Manhattan bodegas; complimentary meals while supplies last.
